description: This file defines the RolesPage React component, which manages role data including viewing, searching, creating, and editing roles. It interacts with external APIs for data fetching and updates, and includes UI logic for role management.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches roles from the primary endpoint, falls back to a secondary endpoint if necessary.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Prepares the form and state for creating a new role.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Populates the form and sets editing mode for an existing role.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form data before saving.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves the new or edited role to the server and reloads data.
